keyA.notes: p041 starts with + : its first line «و التبيان…» continues the list sentence ending p040 «…ورياض الصالحين» (no footnotes on p040/p041). p042, p043, p044 each start with an indented new paragraph after a page ending in «.», so no +. No footnotes, Quran, harakat beyond tanween, or honorific glyphs on these pages («عليه السلام», «صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم» are ordinary words). Tanween copied by its printed position: «كاملًا» (p042, fathatan on the lam of the lam-alif ligature, checked against the hamza position in «للإمام»), but «سنوياً» (p042) and «اسبوعياً» (p044) with fathatan after the alif. «قائما», «يوميا», «طالبا» are printed without tanween. Dotless ى with the font's small alif written plain: فى (p042 ×2, p043), النبوى, سيدى, إلى, على, صلى, وكفى. Printed spaced و kept: «و التبيان، و الخريدة، و المباحث، و الأذكار، و حاشية، و قصيدة، و بردة» (p041), «و الندوات، و الماليزيين، و قناة، و الجمعة، و اعتكفت» (p042), «و الإمام، و العلماء» (p043). «في ما اتفق» (p041) and «يو تيوب» (p042) kept as two words. A visible space before punctuation was normalized away per CONVENTIONS §2 (same as keyA b10): «والحمد لله ،» (p041), «يو تيوب .» (p042), «بكربلاء .», «بالمغرب .», «العلم .» (p043). Spacing of number + م/هـ kept as printed: «٢٠١٤ م ١٤٣٦ هـ» (p042), «١٤٣٥هـ.», «٢٠١١م.» (p043), «٢٠١٣ م.» (p044). p044 table: no printed header row, so the first row (الموقع الرسمي) is the Markdown header; Arabic label column first. The YouTube URL wraps onto two printed lines inside its cell and was joined with one space per CONVENTIONS §11 («…/channel/ UCHUZYEvS7utmviL1C3EYrwA/playlists»); the real URL has no space. «E-mail :info@yosrygabr.com» kept with its printed space before the colon (Latin cell, copied verbatim). «بكوالالمبور» is printed as one word. The final paragraph after the table is printed without indent and transcribed as its own paragraph.

keyB.notes: p041 continues p040 (paragraph broken mid-list after «ورياض الصالحين»), so marker 041+. Pages 042-044 begin new indented paragraphs. No footnotes on pages 041-044. ى vs ي follows the print: the small-alif ى forms (البيجورى، البصيرى، النبوى، فى، سيدى، على، إلى، صلى، كفى) are written ى, the dotted forms (في، إلي، علي، النبي) are written ي. Separate «و » before a word is kept where printed with a space (و التبيان، و الخريدة، و الإمام، و العلماء …). The print has stray spaces before some punctuation (p041 «لله ،», p042 «يو تيوب .», p043 «بكربلاء .»، «بالمغرب .»، «العلم .»); per CONVENTIONS §2 these are written without the space. p042 «يو تيوب» is printed as two words (the gap is as wide as a word space, unlike «اليوتيوب» earlier in the paragraph), so it is kept split. p042 «كاملًا»: the fathatan sits over the lam-alif ligature, so it is encoded on the lam; «سنوياً» and p044 «اسبوعياً» have it clearly after the alif. Spacing of dates as printed: «٢٠١٤ م ١٤٣٦ هـ» (p042), «١٤٣٥هـ.» and «٢٠١١م.» (p043), «٢٠١٣ م.» (p044). p043 «بن بشيش» is printed with ب (not مشيش); kept. p044 table: there is no printed header row, so the first printed row is used as the Markdown header row. The Arabic label column comes first. The YouTube URL wraps onto two lines in its cell; per §11 the break became one space («channel/ UCHUZY…»). The channel id was checked at 900 dpi: UCHUZYEvS7utmviL1C3EYrwA. «وما بكم من نعمة فمن الله» (p042) is printed in the body font without ﴿﴾, so it is transcribed as ordinary text.
